ART 498 [CAPS]

A student may be admitted to the Bachelor of Arts in Art – Studio Option upon completing ART 102 or 103 and 9 credits of 200-300-level art history courses, while maintaining a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.0 in ART courses.

For the Bachelor of Arts in Art a total of at least 39 credits of ART with a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.0 is required; 18 of these credits must be in 300-400-level courses.
